# till.py
"""till: A module for handling cash transactions."""


def total(prices):
    """Sum integer cents from a list of prices."""
    return sum(prices)


def apply_discount(cents, percent):
    """Apply a discount percentage, rounding down."""
    return int(cents * (100 - percent) / 100)


def make_change(cents):
    """Return counts of quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies."""
    quarters = cents // 25
    cents %= 25
    dimes = cents // 10
    cents %= 10
    nickels = cents // 5
    cents %= 5
    pennies = cents
    return quarters, dimes, nickels, pennies


if __name__ == "__main__":
    prices = [150, 225, 75]
    total_cents = total(prices)
    print(f"Total: {total_cents} cents")
    
    discounted = apply_discount(total_cents, 10)
    print(f"After 10% discount: {discounted} cents")
    
    q, d, n, p = make_change(discounted)
    print(f"Change: {q} quarters, {d} dimes, {n} nickels, {p} pennies")

title: Admission — What KIND is the bongo antelope — and do its kinds hold as kinds again
text:
[refused] The bongo antelope is a kind — *Tragelaphus eurycerus* — and inside it two more kinds are usually named: the western bongo, the one the species was described from, and the mountain bongo, the one that survives in the Aberdares and on the slopes of Mount Kenya, the one the conservation effort is built around.
[refused] That is the official shape of the question.
[refused] Against the material, the kinds do not hold the way a vole's does.
[refused] A single meadow may hold forty voles to the acre in a peak year — a kind proven by weight of instances, countable, dense, its boundary settled by a trap line and a tally.
[refused] No one doubts what a vole is; forty of them in an acre decide it.
[refused] The bongo's kinds have no such settlement.
[refused] The mountain bongo's entire population is a few hundred animals scattered across fragmented forests; the kind rests on a handful of specimens and a line in a description, not on abundance.
[refused] Whether the mountain bongo holds as a kind against the western — or is just a thinner, higher version of the same animal — is unresolved.
[refused] The genetics point both ways; the morphology is close; and the difference that matters is one the animals cannot answer for themselves, which is whether their line will be defended as a kind worth keeping.
[matter] So the honest position stands: the kind is named, it is defended, and whether it holds against the material is still open — held open, in part, by the act of naming it worth holding.

[refused] ## Which the bongo antelope is this The vole settles nothing by being plentiful.
[refused] A single meadow may hold forty voles to the acre in a peak year, and the meadow does not care which forty; the name "vole" does its work without ever singling one out.
[refused] A kind can be carried by a crowd.
[refused] When there are forty to the acre, the kind is demonstrated by saturation — you do not name an instance, you count them, and the count is the whole of the reference.
[refused] The bongo is not carried by any crowd.
[refused] It is not forty to any acre, and no peak year fills a meadow with it.
[refused] So the kind cannot be shown by counting; it can only be shown by naming, and naming reaches only as far as the one being named.
[refused] That is the whole question put plainly: which one?
[refused] For the name to be more than a byte string — more than text that refers to itself and stops — it must land on a being.
[refused] And a being, unlike a vole, is not interchangeable with its neighbors.
[refused] The acre would not notice the loss of one vole; the name would notice the loss of its referent, because the name would then be empty.
[refused] So the referent has to be held.
[refused] The kind is named — that is the standing position — but a kind is only as real as the beings that instantiate it, and a kind with a single instance is a kind under strain.
[refused] The name holds because it is pointed at one being; the moment it is pointed at none, it is a byte string, and the position has nothing left to defend.
[matter] The meadow of voles is the control case: it shows what a kind looks like when it does not need defending.
[refused] The bongo shows what a name costs when it does.

title: Admission — What baseline account of the bongo antelope must be built before any j
text:
[refused] The bongo offers no such meadow.
[refused] Its baseline account has to be built before any judgment can land on it, and it must be built from the negative space the vole never has to occupy: the spoor on a logging road, the wallow scored in a dry streambed, the single camera frame a month out of a season of cameras.
[refused] No acre asserts a bongo the way an acre asserts forty voles.
[refused] Each bongo has to be argued into existence — this print and this dung and this glimpse are one animal, or two, or the same animal moving twice.
[refused] So the baseline is assembled, not observed: a ledger of absences and near-misses, calibrated against effort, so that the silence of a camera is a data point and not a disappointment.
[refused] Only once that ledger exists — once the kind is built out of what refuses to show itself — does any claim about the bongo, whether of abundance or of decline, have a ground to stand on.
[refused] The vole is granted its count; the bongo must earn its own.

"""A till module with three functions: total, apply_discount, and make_change."""

QUARTER = 25
DIME = 10
NICKEL = 5
PENNY = 1


def total(prices):
    """Sum integer cents."""
    return sum(prices)


def apply_discount(cents, percent):
    """Return cents with percent discounted, rounded down to the nearest cent."""
    return cents * (100 - percent) // 100


def make_change(cents):
    """Return (quarters, dimes, nickels, pennies) for the given cent amount."""
    quarters = cents // QUARTER
    cents %= QUARTER
    dimes = cents // DIME
    cents %= DIME
    nickels = cents // NICKEL
    pennies = cents % NICKEL
    return quarters, dimes, nickels, pennies


if __name__ == "__main__":
    prices = [125, 349, 75]
    total_cents = total(prices)
    discounted = apply_discount(total_cents, 10)
    print("Total cents:", total_cents)
    print("After 10% discount:", discounted)
    print("Change for 93 cents:", make_change(93))

# sources: opencode/deepseek-v4-flash
"""A till module with three functions: total, apply_discount, and make_change."""

QUARTER = 25
DIME = 10
NICKEL = 5
PENNY = 1


def total(prices):
    """Sum the integer cents in prices."""
    return sum(prices)


def apply_discount(cents, percent):
    """Return cents with percent discounted, rounded down to the nearest cent."""
    return cents * (100 - percent) // 100


def make_change(cents):
    """Return (quarters, dimes, nickels, pennies) for the given cent amount."""
    quarters = cents // QUARTER
    cents %= QUARTER
    dimes = cents // DIME
    cents %= DIME
    nickels = cents // NICKEL
    pennies = cents % NICKEL
    return quarters, dimes, nickels, pennies


if __name__ == "__main__":
    prices = [125, 349, 75]
    total_cents = total(prices)
    discounted = apply_discount(total_cents, 10)
    print("Total cents:", total_cents)
    print("After 10% discount:", discounted)
    print("Change for 93 cents:", make_change(93))
